The relevant assets are the Benchmark (Lab, effectively the de facto public scoring harness, but Java-centric and dated), the Source Code Analysis Tools list (reference only), Find Security Bugs (active OSS tool), and ASST (dormant beta). Teams should use Benchmark plus ASVS mapping for scoring and treat the tools list as a long-list only.

market_trends_2025_2026: AI autofix went mainstream: every Gartner MQ Leader now ships suggested fixes (Veracode Fix, Checkmarx Remediation Assist, Snyk Agent Fix, Fortify Aviator, Black Duck Assist, AppScan RapidFix, Copilot Autofix, GitLab Duo). Autonomous PR generation is still the minority (Contrast SmartFix, SonarQube Remediation Agent, Aikido AutoFix, Veracode Fix for SCA, Corgea, ZeroPath).

AI triage / false-positive filtering became the top differentiator: Semgrep Assistant (96% agreement claim), Fortify Aviator audit, Coverity AI triage on BYO LLM (Jul 2026), Checkmarx Triage Assist, and AI-native entrants (Endor, DryRun, Corgea, ZeroPath, Cycode agentic scanning) claiming 90%+ noise cuts. Independent validation remains thin; OWASP Benchmark does not measure LLM triage.

Agentic development pressure: vendors now integrate with AI coding agents via MCP servers and IDE agents (Checkmarx Developer Assist in Cursor/Windsurf/Copilot, Snyk Evo ADS GA Jun 2026, Sonar Vortex Jun 2026, Coverity MCP, Semgrep MCP, DryRun MCP). Scanning AI-generated code is the dominant marketing narrative (Veracode 2026 GenAI report: 56% secure pass rate).

Licensing and OSS realignment: Semgrep's Dec 2024 move of rules and features behind a non-OSS licence produced the Opengrep fork (Jan 2025) backed by Aikido, Endor Labs, Amplify, Kodem, Orca and others; Opengrep is now the embedded engine for several commercial AI SAST products.

Consolidation and ownership changes: Synopsys SIG became Black Duck under Clearlake/Francisco Partners (Oct 2024) and launched Signal agentic AppSec (Dec 2025/Mar 2026); Cycode absorbed Bearer (2024) and shipped agentic code scanning (Sep 2026); Sonar acquired Gitar (May 2026) and added Remediation Agent/Vortex (Jun 2026); Snyk acquired Invariant Labs and launched the Evo line (2026); Veracode bought Longbow (2024) and Phylum (2025); GitHub split GHAS into Code Security ($30) and Secret Protection ($19) in Apr 2025 and added Code Quality ($10) in Jul 2026.

Analyst picture: Gartner MQ AST Oct 2025 Leaders are Checkmarx, Veracode, OpenText, Black Duck, Snyk and HCLSoftware; Contrast and Sonatype are Visionaries; Semgrep entered for the first time. Forrester Wave SAST Q3 2025 evaluated 10 vendors (Black Duck, Checkmarx, GitHub, GitLab, HCL, Mend, OpenText, Snyk, Sonar, Veracode) with Checkmarx, Snyk, Veracode and GitLab publicly confirmed as Leaders. No 2026 MQ for AST has been published as of Sep 2026 (verified only as a Gartner conference session).

Pricing shifted toward per-contributor/per-committer and credit metering (GitHub, Semgrep, Endor, Snyk Enterprise credits, Aikido credits, GitLab Duo credits); incumbents (Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Coverity, AppScan, Contrast) remain sales-led with no public list price.

top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.reasoning: Only vendor that is a Leader in both Gartner MQ AST 2025 and Forrester SAST Wave Q3 2025 with the highest Current Offering score; broadest language and framework coverage for mixed client estates; GA agentic triage and remediation (Mar 2026) and IDE-agent integrations; multi-tenant plus single-tenant deployment fits multi-client delivery. Watch-outs: price opacity, add-on costs for AI, and cloud-first posture for air-gapped clients.

top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.tool: Veracode Static Analysis with Veracode Fix
top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.reasoning: Dual Leader (Gartner and Forrester), lowest-friction binary scanning with strong policy/compliance reporting that regulated clients expect, and the most mature autofix lineage (Fix since 2023, SCA auto-PRs 2026). Best when clients accept SaaS-only; per-app pricing is predictable for portfolio-style engagements. Not viable for on-prem mandates.

top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.tool: GitLab Ultimate (Advanced SAST + Duo) or GitHub Code Security (CodeQL + Copilot Autofix), chosen by client SCM
top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.reasoning: Platform-native SAST removes integration effort and gives transparent per-user/per-committer pricing; GitLab is a Forrester SAST Leader and supports self-managed/air-gapped delivery with self-hosted AI models, which matters for sovereign and public-sector clients; GitHub gives the strongest open query language (CodeQL) for custom rules. Trade-off: depth and language breadth trail Checkmarx/Veracode/Fortify, and value collapses if the client is not on that platform.

top_3_contenders_for_enterprise_consulti.honourable_mentions: OpenText Fortify for mainframe/ERP (COBOL, ABAP) and government on-prem with Aviator audit; Black Duck Coverity for embedded C/C++ and safety standards; Semgrep for teams that want to own rules and a proven AI triage layer at per-contributor prices; Aikido for SMB clients wanting one console with published pricing.

best_oss_pick.tool: Opengrep (engine) with Semgrep-compatible community rules, complemented by language specialists (Brakeman, gosec, Bandit, SpotBugs+FindSecBugs)
best_oss_pick.reasoning: Opengrep is the only permissively licensed multi-language engine with a funded consortium, SARIF output and a roadmap for cross-file analysis, so it can anchor a free baseline pipeline across 30+ languages and run air-gapped. Pair with the single-language OSS tools for precision where they exist. Semgrep CE remains an option but its rule licensing now restricts commercial redistribution, which matters for a consulting firm packaging accelerators. Score all of them against OWASP Benchmark before recommending to clients.
